caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical object, positioned horizontally and supported by two triangular stands at either end. The cylinder features two large circular end caps, each with a central protruding component and an attached handle. There are two hinged, looped handles on the top of the cylinder, one on each side, as well as two smaller protruding latches on the front face of the cylinder, which also has a large, rectangular inset panel with beveled edges. An additional latch or locking mechanism is visible on one end, affixed via a square mounting plate. The composition is rendered in shades of grey and black pencil on a beige or off-white background. In the upper left corner, there are technical schematics of some of the mechanical features, including a top and side view of the latch mechanism and a rectangular layout possibly indicating how parts fit together. A fine border frames the entire drawing, and the name “Holger Hansen” is inscribed in the lower right corner.
title: Dutch Oven
